query: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY doc_count DESC, id) - 1 AS position FROM rec_features WHERE kind <> 'author' AND doc_count > 0 ), capped AS (SELECT id, position FROM ranked WHERE position < $1), applied AS ( UPDATE rec_features f SET dense_index = c.position FROM capped c WHERE f.id = c.id RETURNING 1 ) SELECT count(*) AS "n!" FROM applied
